-- Janela de consulta: ultimos 15 min, ou desde a 1a queda do alerta aberto mais antigo (para saber quem ainda esta offline). Limite: 7 dias.
SELECT to_char(
  greatest(
    least(localtimestamp - interval '15 min',
          coalesce((SELECT min(primeira_queda) FROM alertas WHERE fechado_em IS NULL), localtimestamp) - interval '1 min'),
    localtimestamp - interval '7 days'),
  'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS desde;

WITH off AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(id_login int, desconectou_em timestamp, motivo text)
), grava AS (
  INSERT INTO quedas (id_login, desconectou_em, motivo)
  SELECT id_login, desconectou_em, motivo FROM off
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING 1
), rec AS (   -- quedas recentes (15 min) de clientes do mapa
  SELECT o.id_login, o.desconectou_em, c.id_transmissor, c.ponid, c.id_caixa_ftth
  FROM off o JOIN clientes_cto c USING (id_login)
  WHERE o.desconectou_em >= localtimestamp - interval '15 min'
), rec_pon AS (
  SELECT r.*, max(r.desconectou_em) OVER (PARTITION BY r.id_transmissor, r.ponid) AS gmax
  FROM rec r WHERE r.ponid IS NOT NULL
), pon AS (   -- PON: >= 5 offline e >= 30%, quedas dentro de 10 min
  SELECT 'PON'::text AS nivel, rp.id_transmissor || '|' || rp.ponid AS chave, t.total,
         array_agg(rp.id_login) AS logins, min(rp.desconectou_em) AS primeira, max(rp.desconectou_em) AS ultima
  FROM rec_pon rp
  JOIN (SELECT id_transmissor, ponid, count(*) AS total FROM clientes_cto GROUP BY 1, 2) t USING (id_transmissor, ponid)
  WHERE rp.desconectou_em >= rp.gmax - interval '10 min'
  GROUP BY rp.id_transmissor, rp.ponid, t.total
  HAVING count(*) >= 5 AND count(*) >= 0.30 * t.total
), rec_cto AS (   -- CTO: so fora de PON em alerta (novo ou aberto)
  SELECT r.*, max(r.desconectou_em) OVER (PARTITION BY r.id_caixa_ftth) AS gmax
  FROM rec r
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pon p WHERE p.chave = r.id_transmissor || '|' || r.ponid)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alertas a WHERE a.nivel = 'PON' AND a.fechado_em IS NULL
                    AND a.chave = r.id_transmissor || '|' || r.ponid)
), cto AS (   -- CTO: >= 2 offline e >= 60%, quedas dentro de 10 min
  SELECT 'CTO'::text, rc.id_caixa_ftth::text, t.total,
         array_agg(rc.id_login), min(rc.desconectou_em), max(rc.desconectou_em)
  FROM rec_cto rc
  JOIN (SELECT id_caixa_ftth, count(*) AS total FROM clientes_cto GROUP BY 1) t USING (id_caixa_ftth)
  WHERE rc.desconectou_em >= rc.gmax - interval '10 min'
  GROUP BY rc.id_caixa_ftth, t.total
  HAVING count(*) >= 2 AND count(*) >= 0.60 * t.total
), cand AS (
  SELECT * FROM pon UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cto
)
INSERT INTO alertas AS a (nivel, chave, total, logins, afetados, primeira_queda, ultima_queda, evento)
SELECT nivel, chave, total, logins, cardinality(logins), primeira, ultima, 'novo' FROM cand
ON CONFLICT (nivel, chave) WHERE fechado_em IS NULL DO UPDATE SET
  logins       = ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT unnest(a.logins || EXCLUDED.logins)),
  afetados     = cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT unnest(a.logins || EXCLUDED.logins))),
  ultima_queda = greatest(a.ultima_queda, EXCLUDED.ultima_queda),
  -- ja notificado e cresceu 50% ou mais: marca 'agravado' para notificar de novo
  evento = CASE WHEN a.notificado_em IS NOT NULL
                 AND cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT unnest(a.logins || EXCLUDED.logins)))
                     >= 1.5 * coalesce(a.afetados_notificados, a.afetados)
                THEN 'agravado' ELSE a.evento END,
  notificado_em = CASE WHEN a.notificado_em IS NOT NULL
                 AND cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT unnest(a.logins || EXCLUDED.logins)))
                     >= 1.5 * coalesce(a.afetados_notificados, a.afetados)
                THEN NULL ELSE a.notificado_em END
RETURNING a.id, a.nivel, a.chave, a.afetados, a.total, a.evento;

-- Fecha alerta quando >= 80% dos afetados voltaram (ou seja, <= 20% ainda offline)
WITH off AS (
  SELECT id_login FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(id_login int)
), st AS (
  SELECT a.id, cardinality(a.logins) AS n,
         (SELECT count(*) FROM unnest(a.logins) AS l(id) WHERE l.id IN (SELECT id_login FROM off)) AS ainda
  FROM alertas a
  WHERE a.fechado_em IS NULL AND a.aberto_em < now() - interval '4 min'
)
UPDATE alertas a SET fechado_em = now(), evento = 'normalizado', notificado_em = NULL
FROM st
WHERE a.id = st.id AND st.ainda <= 0.2 * st.n
RETURNING a.id, a.nivel, a.chave, st.n AS afetados, st.ainda AS ainda_offline,
          to_char(now() - a.aberto_em, 'HH24:MI') AS duracao;
